blocks.title: Predict: solve angle, reference-angle, and exact-value problems
content: Which problems need a sketch before any calculation?
instructor_notes: Require an individual prediction before discussion.

blocks.title: solve angle, reference-angle, and exact-value problems
content: Use coterminal reduction, reference angles, ASTC, and special triangles as one connected workflow.

blocks.title: Model the Skill: solve angle, reference-angle, and exact-value problems
content: Find the remaining ratios when $\cos\theta=9/41$ in Quadrant I, then analyze $-97^\circ$.
verification: Verify all Test 3 angle and exact-value answers.
steps: The missing leg is 40, so $\sin\theta=40/41$ and $\tan\theta=40/9$.
$-97^\circ$ is coterminal with $263^\circ$ in Quadrant III.

blocks.title: You Try: solve angle, reference-angle, and exact-value problems
content: Find $\sin225^\circ$. Then find a positive coterminal angle and reference angle for $-97^\circ$.

blocks.title: Check and Diagnose: solve angle, reference-angle, and exact-value problems
content: Check calculator mode and retain exact radicals when requested.
instructor_notes: Ask students to explain why the incorrect path fails.
verification: Verify all Test 3 angle and exact-value answers.

blocks.title: Make It Stick: solve angle, reference-angle, and exact-value problems
content: Write the order: sketch, reference angle, sign, exact value.

blocks.title: Predict: solve right-triangle, area, and two-triangle applications
content: What distinguishes a one-triangle problem from a shared-height two-triangle problem?
instructor_notes: Require an individual prediction before discussion.

blocks.title: solve right-triangle, area, and two-triangle applications
content: Use inverse trig to find angles, Pythagorean theorem for missing sides, and $A=\tfrac12bc\sin A$ for included-angle area.

blocks.title: Model the Skill: solve right-triangle, area, and two-triangle applications
content: Solve a right triangle with leg $a=11$, hypotenuse $c=35$, then find area for $A=76^\circ$, $b=34$, $c=21$.
verification: Verify Test 3 triangle and application results.

blocks.title: You Try: solve right-triangle, area, and two-triangle applications
content: Observation points 50 ft apart measure tower elevation angles $53^\circ$ and $31^\circ$. Find the tower height.

blocks.title: Check and Diagnose: solve right-triangle, area, and two-triangle applications
content: Draw and label before substituting.
Use square units for area.
instructor_notes: Ask students to explain why the incorrect path fails.
verification: Verify Test 3 triangle and application results.

blocks.title: perform vector operations and direction calculations
content: Operations are component-wise; magnitude and direction use the Pythagorean theorem and inverse tangent.

blocks.title: Model the Skill: perform vector operations and direction calculations
content: Find the vector from $P=(3,-1)$ to $Q=(-2,4)$, then its magnitude and direction.
steps: The Quadrant II direction angle is $135^\circ$.

blocks.title: You Try: perform vector operations and direction calculations
content: Find magnitude and direction of $\langle-5,5\rangle$.

blocks.title: Check and Diagnose: perform vector operations and direction calculations
content: Use terminal minus initial.
Check quadrant before accepting inverse tangent.
instructor_notes: Ask students to explain why the incorrect path fails.
